description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and constants for managing iframe-based challenge previews, including scroll position management, test runner setup, and frame initialization in a web-based coding challenge environment.

classes.name: ScrollManager
classes.description: Manages scroll position state for iframe previews, including registering scroll events and restoring scroll position.

methods.name: getContentDocument
methods.description: Retrieves the content document of an iframe by its ID.

methods.name: waitForFrame
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the iframe element has finished loading.

methods.name: createHeader
methods.description: Generates the initial HTML header and script for the iframe, including error handling and link interception.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates the full HTML content for an iframe, including header and body.

methods.name: restoreScrollPosition
methods.description: Registers scroll event listener and restores previous scroll position in iframe.

methods.name: createFramer
methods.description: Builds a composed function to initialize and manage iframe frames with various setup steps.
